note: A scope is shown to passengers only when an entry here names it field for field, including the display protocol and the SHA-256 of the confirmation results it approves: {"operator": "BNML", "line": "15", "direction": "outbound", "patternIds": ["BNML:15:outbound:c9291c1aea"], "model": "blended@9a626129f782", "protocol": "display-1", "confirmationDigest": "<from public/data/arrival-release.json, once the window is complete>"}. The digest exists only once the results do, so an entry written beforehand approves nothing, and results never approve themselves; a bare direction approves nothing either. 29 September 2026: nothing approved, in either direction, on the owner's instruction; 6 October is when the confirmation results are read, not a release date. On the revision days (21-26 September) both directions fail: outbound median 1.70 and p80 4.00 min; inbound shown on 2.1% of the moments its buses were 2-10 min away. A change to the model or the display is a new protocol version with its own untouched window (pipeline/arrival_protocol.py).
